title: To-Do List App
description: Build a to-do list app with full CRUD operations — add tasks, toggle completion, and delete items by managing an array of task objects.

steps.title: Create the task data structure
steps.description: Define an array of task objects where each task has `id`, `title`, and `completed` fields. Log the array using `JSON.stringify`.
hints: Each task is an object: { id: 1, title: '...', completed: false }
Create an array with 3 sample tasks: one incomplete, two complete
Use console.log(JSON.stringify(tasks)) to see the full array

verification.successMessage: Task data structure is ready with id, title, and completed fields!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure the tasks array contains objects with the required fields and sample data.

steps.title: Add a task function
steps.description: Write an `addTask` function that takes a `title`, creates a new task object with a unique id, and appends it to the tasks array. Log the updated array.
hints: Generate a new id: tasks.length + 1 or Math.max(...tasks.map(t => t.id)) + 1
New tasks always start with completed: false
Use tasks.push(newTask) to add, then log JSON.stringify(tasks)

verification.successMessage: New tasks can be added to the list!
verification.failureMessage: addTask should create a task with a unique id and the given title, then push it to the tasks array.

steps.title: Render the task list
steps.description: Write a `renderTasks` function that logs each task on its own line. Incomplete tasks show `[ ]` and complete tasks show `[x]`, like: `[ ] 1. Buy groceries`.
hints: Loop through tasks with forEach or a for loop
Use template literals or string concatenation to format the line

verification.successMessage: Tasks render with status indicators showing completion!
verification.failureMessage: Incomplete tasks should show '[ ]' and complete tasks should show '[x]' before the task info.

steps.title: Toggle task completion
steps.description: Write a `toggleComplete` function that takes a task `id`, finds the matching task, and flips its `completed` value. Log the state before and after.
hints: Use .find() or findIndex() to locate the task by id: tasks.find(t => t.id === id)
Log both before and after values to verify the toggle

verification.successMessage: Task completion can be toggled on and off!
verification.failureMessage: toggleComplete should find the task by id and negate its completed property.

steps.title: Delete a task
steps.description: Write a `deleteTask` function that removes a task by `id`. Show the task count before and after deletion.
hints: Use .filter() to create a new array without the deleted task: tasks = tasks.filter(t => t.id !== id)
Log the array length before and after deletion

verification.successMessage: Tasks can be removed! Your full CRUD todo list is complete.
verification.failureMessage: deleteTask should remove the task matching the given id, reducing the array length from 3 to 2.
